tasks.task: Implement ReportGenerator class (AC: #1) Create rustybt/validation/reporting.py module Define ReportGenerator class with session dependency injection Implement generate_markdown() method for markdown output Implement generate_json() method for JSON output Test: Unit tests for report generation with mock session data

Implement report template structure (AC: #1) Create markdown template with session header section Implement summary table generation with findings counts Implement per-layer results section generation Implement findings detail section with classification info Test: Verify output matches expected markdown structure

Add CLI report command (AC: #2, #3) Add report command to rustybt/validation/cli.py Implement --format option (markdown default, json optional) Load session from session_id, validate exists Call ReportGenerator with appropriate format Test: CLI integration tests for both formats

Implement report file saving (AC: #4) Save report to session directory path Handle both markdown and JSON file extensions Ensure directory exists before saving Report saved path in console output Test: Verify files saved to correct locations

Implement auto-generation on completion (AC: #5) Hook into SessionManager status change Trigger report generation when status → COMPLETED Add timestamp to report metadata Test: Integration test for auto-generation
Write comprehensive tests (AC: #1-5) Unit tests for ReportGenerator class Integration tests for CLI commands Test with various session states Test with BUG, DESIGN, and mixed findings

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given a completed or in-progress session When report generation is invoked Then a markdown report is generated with session header, summary table, layer results sections, and findings detail section
CLI command rustybt-validate report session_id produces markdown report saved to validation-sessions/{session_id}/report.md
CLI command rustybt-validate report session_id --format json produces JSON output suitable for programmatic use
Reports are automatically saved to session directory (report.md and report.json)
Report auto-generation on session completion when status changes to COMPLETED
